question: In what year was the college founded, originally as a Catholic high school?
explanation: It was founded in 1873. The year 1707 marks the first elementary school in Arad, from which the institution traces its roots.

question: Which architectural style is the college building built in?
explanation: The building was constructed between 1869 and 1873 in Renaissance style.

question: In which year did the school readopt the name “Moise Nicoară”?
explanation: The old name came back in 1991. In 1919 the school first received the name; 1965 is when it became a high school again.
